programs.name: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A in three A levels including A in Mathematics
programs.ib_offer: 36 points overall and 7, 7, 6 in three Higher Level subjects including 6 in either HL Mathematics
programs.ap_offer: 5, 5, 5 in three Advanced Placement Tests including Calculus BC (Calculus AB, AP Seminar and AP Research are not accepted as one of the three). Assessed individually; the university also looks at breadth (additional APs, wider curriculum, SAT or ACT scores if taken). If APs are not available, honours, dual enrolment or equivalent advanced classes (about one in place of each AP) may be considered case by case.
programs.required_subjects: A level Mathematics at grade A (or IB HL Mathematics at 6); IB SL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches may be considered with a different offer; SL Applications & Interpretations not accepted
programs.toefl_note: English Category C. TOEFL iBT taken up to 21 January 2026 (0-120 scale): 90 overall with at least 21 in all 4 components. TOEFL iBT taken after 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in all components.
programs.english_note: English Category C applies if you do not hold GCSE English Language/Literature grade 4/C (or equivalent). PTE Academic 62 (59 in each element); Duolingo 120 overall (taken after 1 July 2024, with sub scores of at least Speaking 110, Writing 110, Reading 110, Listening 105).
programs.notes: 2027 entry page. Typical offer shown; alternative offer A*AA or A*A*B with an EPQ/IEPQ at A (or similar extra study). Contextual offer AAA or A*AB. IB alternative: SL Maths Analysis & Approaches considered at 36 points with 7, 6, 6 or 7, 7, 5 at HL plus 7 in SL Maths. Overseas application deadline listed on the page: 13 January 2027. International fee: the 2027 page says fee information is not yet available, so none is stored (the 2026/27 overseas fee on https://www.bath.ac.uk/courses/undergraduate-2026/computer-science/bsc-computer-science/ was GBP 32,000 per year and the university says to budget for rises of up to 8% a year). AP route: same page, United States of America section.

programs.name: Economics BSc (Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA in three A levels including Mathematics
programs.ib_offer: 36 points overall and 7, 6, 6 in three Higher Level subjects including either HL Mathematics
programs.ap_offer: 5, 5, 5 in three Advanced Placement Tests including Calculus AB or Calculus BC. No more than one Calculus AP counts towards the three; AP Seminar and AP Research are not accepted. Assessed individually.
programs.required_subjects: A level Mathematics (or IB HL Mathematics, either course); IB SL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches may be considered with a different offer; SL Applications & Interpretations not accepted
programs.toefl_note: English Category B. TOEFL iBT taken up to 21 January 2026 (0-120 scale): 100 overall with at least 24 in all 4 components. TOEFL iBT taken after 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 5 overall with at least 4.5 in all components.
programs.english_note: English Category B applies if you do not hold GCSE English Language/Literature grade 4/C (or equivalent). PTE Academic 69 (62 in each element); Duolingo 130 overall (taken after 1 July 2024, with sub scores of at least Speaking 120, Writing 130, Reading 120, Listening 115).
programs.notes: 2027 entry page. Typical offer shown; alternative offer AAA or A*AB in three A levels including Mathematics plus an extra qualification (e.g. A in AS Further Maths). Contextual offer AAB. IB contextual offer 36 points with 6, 6, 5 at HL. Overseas application deadline listed on the page: 13 January 2027. International fee: the 2027 page says fee information is not yet available, so none is stored (the 2026/27 overseas fee on https://www.bath.ac.uk/courses/undergraduate-2026/economics/bsc-economics/ was GBP 28,650 per year). AP route: same page, United States of America section.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng (Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A in three A levels including A* in Mathematics and A in Physics
programs.ib_offer: 36 points overall and 7, 7, 6 in three Higher Level subjects including 6 in Physics and 7 in either HL Mathematics
programs.ap_offer: 5, 5, 5 in three Advanced Placement Tests including Calculus BC and Physics 1; or 5, 5, 5 including Calculus BC and two from Physics 2, Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism and Physics C: Mechanics. Assessed individually.
programs.required_subjects: A level Mathematics (A*) and Physics (A); IB Mathematics at Higher Level (either course) and Physics
programs.toefl_note: English Category C. TOEFL iBT taken up to 21 January 2026 (0-120 scale): 90 overall with at least 21 in all 4 components. TOEFL iBT taken after 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in all components.
programs.english_note: English Category C applies if you do not hold GCSE English Language/Literature grade 4/C (or equivalent). PTE Academic 62 (59 in each element); Duolingo 120 overall (taken after 1 July 2024).
programs.notes: 2027 entry page for the 3-year BEng (T120). The 4-year MEng Mechanical Engineering (T122) lists the same A level, IB and AP offers: https://www.bath.ac.uk/courses/undergraduate-2027/mechanical-engineering/meng-mechanical-engineering/. Alternative offer A*AA or A*A*B with extra study; contextual offer AAA or A*AB. Overseas application deadline listed on the page: 13 January 2027. International fee: the 2027 page says fee information is not yet available, so none is stored (the 2026/27 overseas fee on https://www.bath.ac.uk/courses/undergraduate-2026/mechanical-engineering/beng-mechanical-engineering/ was GBP 32,000 per year). AP route: same page, American qualifications section.
